title: Error messages for common provider failures are short and readable
hypothesis: 503, bad key, unknown model and timeouts all map to plain sentences without JSON.
notes: overloaded: "Google Gemini is temporarily overloaded or unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes. (503)" | badKey: "Google Gemini rejected the API key. Check it in Settings → AI providers. (400: API key not valid. Please pass a valid API key.)" | noModel: "Google Gemini couldn't find that model. Choose another in Settings → AI providers. (404: models/gemini-9 is not found)" | timeout: "Google Gemini didn't respond in time. Please try again. (No response after 60s.)"
